prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW ORIGINAL MOOGLE BARD for an FFTA GBA expansion, from a blank character design rather than a reskin of an old job. Match Final Fantasy Tactics Advance Moogle anatomy and isometric chibi native sprite style: small cream-furred face with protruding tan muzzle, black eyes, tall rabbitlike ears, red-orange round pompom on thin antenna, tiny dark purple bat wings, very small body and oversized feet. This is a traveling musician: floppy muted crimson feather cap with ear holes, teal-green split-tail short coat, pale gold scarf, brown belt and rounded boots, small pear-shaped wooden lute slung across the back with neck visible above one shoulder. Keep the cap low so the ears/pompom remain visible. Large readable simple shapes and face, warm dark colored pixel outline, limited15color clustered native GBA shading. Four complete full-body sprites on a transparent square sheet in2equal columns and2equal rows. Left column canonical front-left three-quarter, right column canonical back-right three-quarter. Row1 neutral stance; row2 subtle lowered idle pose, same outfit/scale/anatomy. Each figure contained in inner60percent of its cell, clear20percent transparent margins on ALL sides; no ears, lute, wings or pompom crossing borders. Character including pompom should read as about24pixels tall on32x32 native canvas, simple large square pixels rather than fine high resolution pixel texture. Preserve distinct silhouette of feather, split coat and lute, no other weapons. No words, musical notation, labels, grid, frame, backdrop, ground shadow, antialiasing, gradients or watermark. True alpha transparency.
